function isElementInViewport (el) {
    if (typeof jQuery === "function" && el instanceof jQuery) {
        el = el[0];
    }
    var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    return (
        rect.top >= 0 &&
        rect.left >= 0 &&
        rect.bottom <= (window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight) && /*or $(window).height() */
        rect.right <= (window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth) /*or $(window).width() */
    );
}

function num_word(value, words){  
	value = Math.abs(value) % 100; 
	var num = value % 10;
	if(value > 10 && value < 20) return words[2]; 
	if(num > 1 && num < 5) return words[1];
	if(num == 1) return words[0]; 
	return words[2];
}

<script>

    function scroll_fix_left() {    	
        var a = document.querySelector('.left_col_bott');
        var b = document.querySelector('#desktop_filter');
        var c = $(window).height() - 51;
        var e = $('header').height() + 10;
        var d = $(window).height() - (e+30);
        var fs = document.querySelector('aside');
        fixPoint = $(this).scrollTop();
        
        if(a.getBoundingClientRect().y <= e) {
            if(!b.classList.contains('fixed_block')){
                b.classList.add("fixed_block")
            }
            if(window.scrollPointLeft < fixPoint){//down
                if(b.getBoundingClientRect().bottom <= c){
                    var footer_cont = document.querySelector('.nbFooter');
                    if(b.getBoundingClientRect().bottom+10 >= footer_cont.getBoundingClientRect().top) {
                        if(!b.classList.contains('footer_fix')){
                            //translate_var = 0 - (a.getBoundingClientRect().y-b.getBoundingClientRect().y)
                            translate_var = (footer_cont.offsetTop - fs.getBoundingClientRect().height - b.getBoundingClientRect().height) - 150;
                            b.style.cssText ='position: relative; transform: translate3d(0px, '+ translate_var +'px, 0px);';
                            b.classList.add('footer_fix')
                        }else{
                            // b.classList.remove('footer_fix')
                            // if(b.getBoundingClientRect().height > d){
                                // b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; bottom: '+ 51 +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);top: auto;';
                            // }else{
                                // b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; top: '+ e +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);bottom: auto;';  
                            // }
                        }
                    }else{
                        if(!b.classList.contains('footer_fix')){
                            if(b.getBoundingClientRect().height > d){
                                b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; bottom: '+ 51 +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);top: auto;';
                            }else{
                                b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; top: '+ e +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);bottom: auto;';  
                            }
                        }else{
                            if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
                                let footerObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries, observer) {
                                    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
                                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                                        }else{
                                            b.classList.remove('footer_fix')
                                            if(b.getBoundingClientRect().height > d){
                                                b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; bottom: '+ 51 +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);top: auto;';
                                            }else{
                                                b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; top: '+ e +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);bottom: auto;';  
                                            }
                                        }
                                    });
                                });
                                footerObserver.observe(footer_cont);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }else{
                    if(b.getBoundingClientRect().height > d){
                        translate_var = 0 - (a.getBoundingClientRect().y-b.getBoundingClientRect().y)
                        b.style.cssText ='position: relative; transform: translate3d(0px, '+ translate_var +'px, 0px);';
                    }
                }    
            }else{//up
                b.classList.remove('footer_fix')
                if(b.getBoundingClientRect().top >= e){
                    b.style.cssText ='position: fixed; width: ' + a.offsetWidth + 'px; top: '+ e +'px;transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);bottom: auto;';
                }else{
                    if(b.getBoundingClientRect().height > d){
                        translate_var = 0 - (a.getBoundingClientRect().y-b.getBoundingClientRect().y)
                        b.style.cssText ='position: relative; transform: translate3d(0px, '+ translate_var +'px, 0px);';
                    }
                }
            }
            window.scrollPointLeft = fixPoint;
        }else{
            b.style.cssText = '';
            b.classList.remove("fixed_block")
        }
    }
</script>
